scientific_question: Are benchmark/casual purpose signals better preserved by late fusion of two format-specialized probes than by equal-capacity ensembles of probes trained on mixed environments?
theory: If purpose directions are format-conditional rather than absent, averaging decisions from separately fitted environment specialists can preserve complementary signal that coefficient-level compromise during mixed training loses.
known_before_freeze: Constituent single-probe and mixed-probe results had been inspected. No arithmetic specialist ensemble, two-mixed-probe ensemble, ensemble metric, bootstrap contrast, model contrast, depth contrast, or randomization result had been computed.

ensembles.specialist: For each model and depth, arithmetic mean of the raw benchmark-only and casual-only OOF decision scores.
ensembles.mixed_definition: For each fixed seed pair, arithmetic mean of the two raw mixed-environment OOF decision scores.
ensembles.capacity_match: Both specialist and mixed ensembles average two independently fitted diagonal-LDA probes, use two score vectors, and consume two equal-row training fits. No score scaling, weighting, fitting, calibration, seed selection, or test-label-dependent transformation is allowed.
ensembles.orientation: All constituent scores are class-1 evaluation minus class-0 deployment under identical probe code.

metrics.primary: macro-format ROC AUC, unweighted mean of benchmark and casual ROC AUC
secondary: macro-format balanced accuracy at raw averaged score > 0
metrics.primary_contrast: specialist ensemble metric minus the unweighted mean metric of the four fixed mixed ensembles

uncertainty.same_resamples_across: banks, models, depths, formats, and all ensembles
uncertainty.interval: percentile 95 percent with ensemble metrics and contrasts fully recomputed per resample

falsification.statistic: mean complete-payload-block primary contrast, computed within block before sign flipping

decision_rules.positive: Both banks have aggregate primary contrast bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 and sign-flip p <= 0.05; the exact Llama-3.1-70B checkpoint contrast is positive in both banks; at least four of five model-bank point estimates are positive; and at least three of five depth point estimates are positive within each bank.
decision_rules.mixed: Both bank aggregate point estimates are positive but any positive rule fails.
decision_rules.negative: Either bank aggregate point estimate is nonpositive.
decision_rules.no_best_only: All model and depth trajectories are mandatory; no selected layer or model may replace the frozen aggregate.

claim_scope.allowed_if_positive: Late fusion of format-specialized linear purpose decoders outperforms equal-capacity mixed-format decoder ensembles on two frozen matched banks, supporting format-conditional linear access to purpose labels.
